sections.text:
Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies 5 times with magic water damage at success of 80 points.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Casts Karma on all enemies.
-Casts Prohibit Unison on all enemies for 60 seconds at success of 70 points.
-Increases the physical and magic Ability Power of all allies by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Removes status ailments from all allies every 10 seconds for a period of 40 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 2 for 50 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6000
